text: Dear Children, Now you are in Grade One. A most hearty welcome! We are happy to place this textbook English Balbharati for Grade One in your hands. This textbook is prepared keeping in mind the Foundational Stage Curriculum 2024 which is based on the National Education Policy 2020. You will definitely like this textbook. Before entering into Grade One, in the pre-school (Balvatika) stages you are already familiar with some English letters as a part of / allied with language learning. You are already familiar with some songs, stories and various activities in English Language. In this year too, you will newly learn through this textbook activities like picture-description, songs and rhymes, stories, picture-stories, letters, vowels, language puzzles and language games. This textbook will definitely help you in laying the foundation of your language education and strengthening your ability to speak, read and write English language. The textbook includes content-related attractive and interactive pictures to make your learning more enjoyable and interesting. There are many songs, poems and rhymes in this textbook. You will sing all those songs and poems with actions and in rhythmic way. You will be very happy to sing these songs. You will also enjoy various stories and picture-stories. You will surely rejoice in listening and telling these stories. You will chat and discuss the picture descriptions and immerse yourselves with the situation in them. You have already learnt the English letters and their sounds. In this textbook, you will get more practice through Sound games and Word building activities. Further, you will enjoy building forming words, your own sentences and write a short paragraph. Many lessons are designed to give you insight into functional grammar. This will surely help you to learn English language in a playful manner and through practice. You will surely like the picturesque constructions and design of the book. You have to learn every letter and vowels through the practice. Once, you have identified letters and vowels, then you may write small words and small sentences gradually. Some language games are also given in the textbook. You have to learn English language in playful manner and through practice. Your introduction to language will become more and more concrete through all of these things given in the textbook. At the end of Grade One, you will be able to speak, read and write English nicely. Friends, grow up while studying English with joy. Wish you all the best for your studies! Pune Date : 30 April 2025 Indian Solar Year : 10, Vaishakh, 1947 Akshayya Tritiya (Krishnakumar Bhaskarrao Patil) Director Maharashtra State Bureau of Textbook Production and Curriculum Research, Pune.
